title: Checked matrix source preview

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.

allowedWork: Bounded source-session APIs, optional preview host, failure recovery and complete-cost preservation.
disallowedWork: New visuals, dimensions, arbitrary choreography, calculus changes, agents or external publication.
goal: An author can load, explicitly apply, inspect and export matrix source edits through the accepted player.
commitCadence: Commit each verified package and push at least hourly and before handoff.
stopConditions: Four-hour ceiling with forty-five-minute closeout reserve; stop implementation at reserve.
Stop for user pause, required subjective review or genuine authority/external blocker.

slices.summary: Checked matrix drafts and transactional session reuse existing revision owner; ten focused tests pass.
